lessons.claim: ★ The numerator of the Peclet/Weissenberg number is the strain-rate magnitude |E| and not |grad u| (vorticity merely rotates the particle uniformly and cannot change an isotropic equilibrium distribution). The convention is |E| = sqrt(2 E:E) -- using sqrt(E:E) is wrong by a factor sqrt(2)=1.414. A pure rotational flow has Pe=0 however large |grad u| is. For a near-sphere (r-1<<1) the right scale is |E|(r-1)/Dr, so writing |E|/Dr overestimates
